name: instructions
description: AI coding agent instruction & configuration manager (formerly @hasna/configs). CLI + MCP + HTTP API (instructions-serve) + generated SDK at the ./sdk export. The CLI, the MCP server and the SDK are hosted-by-default clients of the /v1 API: each call resolves its API key and authority through the one @hasna/contracts client chain (HASNA_INSTRUCTIONS_API_KEY / HASNA_INSTRUCTIONS_API_URL, the macOS Keychain item hasna.credentials.instructions.api-key, ~/.hasna/instructions/config/credentials, default https://api.hasna.com/instructions) and fails closed with no credential; the on-box sqlite store is opened only by the explicit opt-in HASNA_INSTRUCTIONS_LOCAL=1. Server data backend is postgresql when HASNA_INSTRUCTIONS_DATABASE_URL is set, else sqlite. The serve process reads/writes the shared Postgres directly with API-key auth via @hasna/contracts. The MCP server keeps the legacy name 'configs' aliased for the existing fleet.

mcp.name: configs
mcp.note: MCP server identity intentionally kept as 'configs' so the 17-machine fleet MCP config keeps working; fleet rename is a separate controlled step.
